translations.web: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
translations.bsb: Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door!
translations.kjv: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
translations.asv: Murmur not, brethren, one against another, that ye be not judged: behold, the judge standeth before the doors.
